release_notes:
SGB Browser v2.0.43 Official Complete Release:
• Upgraded Bot #7 ('🔍 Filter' / Headless GraphQL Number Filter Engine) to support up to 50 Worker Threads (1–50) with Per-Worker Multi-Session Token Pooling (datr + lsd), Automatic Direct No-VPN International Account Detection, and Zero False 'No Account Found' verification.
• Fixed Bot #7 Row 2 UI dropdown overlap ('Gateway' & 'Method') and expanded 'Threads' (1–20), 'Delay', and 'Worker Threads' (1–50) counter spinboxes with centered high-contrast styling for 100% visibility across all display sizes and DPI scalings.
• Fixed 'Get Token Cookie' extension import & 1-click auto-login, full cookie capture (c_user + xs + fr + datr + sb), accurate UID extraction, and 5-format Save/Copy/Import/Export (UID|Pass|2FA|Cookie, UID|Pass|Cookie, UID|Cookie, Only Cookie, Only UID).
• Fixed StudioFramelessModal initialization hook in Profile Info, Top-Bar '📁 Groups', and Video Publisher modals.
• Updated Sidebar '🌐 Site' button to open official Telegram channel (https://t.me/Sjrgui) and enforced 100% End-to-End Password & Group integrity.
